changelog: Every device now gets the 'Register Control Example' dashboard (Comfort outputs/flags + counters/sensors) with correct contents, renamed in the sidebar. Previously this only existed as manual per-device edits (cytech.local 2026-08-10, ems.local 2026-08-11) and drifted: ems.local's storage file held a UI-created placeholder (a 'sections' view with a 'New section' heading) under the legacy id dashboard_automation, and clones from the stale golden image carry a registry entry with no storage file at all. New ensure_register_control_dashboard() in first_boot.sh's maintenance branch self-heals on every boot: creates the storage file when missing, replaces only placeholder content (never a customized dashboard), renames the sidebar title to 'Register Control Example' whichever id exists, and registers the canonical automation-dashboard id when neither exists. Storage mode, so users can edit it in the UI.
